test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate form and tense of the bracketed verb in the following sentence to fill in the blank.

I'm busy today. I'd rather we________ [has] the meeting tomorrow.
solution:
The correct answer is '**had**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb "**had**" is the simple past tense form of the verb "**have**."
 
• In this context, "**had**" is used to express a preference for a meeting to occur in the future, specifically "tomorrow".
 
• **Options 2, 3**, and **4** are grammatically incorrect in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"I'm busy today. I'd rather we **had**__ the meeting tomorrow."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "had been"** is incorrect because it implies a continuous action in the past, which does not fit the context.
 
• **Option 3: "has"** is incorrect because it is the present tense form and does not fit the context.
 
• **Option 4: "Has been"** is incorrect because it is the present perfect continuous tense and does not fit the context.
